meaning: 'Born of the Jewel' — the Dhyānibuddha of the southern jewel family

pronunciation.approximation: Say "ratnasambhava" with the stress and length implied by the scholarly restoration "Ratnasambhava".
pronunciation.note: The ASCII form "ratnasambhava" is a DNS compromise; the restoration "Ratnasambhava" preserves the name's scholarly dignity.

domains.title: Ratnasambhava
domains.subtitle: Jewel-Born
domains.lead: Ratnasambhava is jewel-born, south. The name means "'Born of the Jewel' — the Dhyānibuddha of the southern jewel family" and belongs to the buddhist tradition.

cards.name: Sacred Name

cards.name: Living Tradition

mythology.lead: The stories of Ratnasambhava place jewel-born, south at the center of a living mythological world.

myths.title: Origins
myths.text: Ratnasambhava appears in buddhist tradition as jewel-born, south. The name's meaning, "'Born of the Jewel' — the Dhyānibuddha of the southern jewel family", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

myths.title: Worship and Memory
myths.text: Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Ratnasambhava in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.

lore.culturalLegacy: Ratnasambhava remains a touchstone for understanding buddhist religion, art, and identity.
